counterfactual_missing_items: no primary clear-cell carcinoma such as renal cell carcinoma is identified
prostatic adenocarcinoma is explicitly without metastasis
no basaloid palisading or connection to epidermis to support clear-cell basal cell carcinoma
decisive_items: a high-grade clear-cell squamous cell carcinoma
large irregular nests and lobules of clear cells with abundant multivacuolated cytoplasm, nuclear indentations, and vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei
response.rationale: C1 exactly matches the supplied differential phrase and is corroborated by pagetoid clear-cell morphology and lymphovascular invasion. R1 is the main alternative but lacks a primary clear-cell source and is contradicted by the prostate cancer being without metastasis. R3 is a correlated restatement of C1 without the high-grade modifier. R5 relies only on unrelated prior BCC history and lacks basaloid histology.

rejected.why: Correlated restatement of C1; lacks the high-grade modifier and is superseded by C1.
Only prior nodular BCC history; histology shows pagetoid infiltrative clear-cell SCC, not basaloid features.
